title: Normalized Hermite series term
statement:
For every nonnegative integer $j$ and real numbers $x,t$, the $j$th term formed from the normalized Hermite polynomial satisfies
\[
H_j(x)\frac{t^j}{\sqrt{j!}}=\operatorname{He}_j(x)\frac{t^j}{j!},
\]
where $\operatorname{He}_j$ is the (unnormalized) Hermite polynomial of degree $j$.
